How often does England's tap water pass its tests? 💧
The Drinking Water Inspectorate's 2025 report says 99.97% of regulatory samples from public supplies met the standards, across more than 3.5 million samples. Of 982 failed tests, 447 were linked to consumers' own distribution systems. The DWI also served 109 enforcement notices.

Do you drink straight from the tap? Comment your town 👇
Source: Drinking Water Inspectorate, Chief Inspector's report 2025
